findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the soda nozzle holder at the bar to contain an accumulation of soil debris. Person in charge (PIC) stated the facility switched from Coke to Pepsi, and they may have left an older nozzle holder. CORRECTED- PIC wiped the area with a clean sanitizer rag. Ensure food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent accumulation of soil debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed dried food splash and other food debris accumulated in the microwave’s interior. CORRECTED- PIC wiped the interior of the microwave with a clean sanitizing rag. An accumulation of debris on nonfood contact surfaces may serve as a source of contamination for ready to eat (RTE) foods. Ensure nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.11: There is observed bare wood at the bar behind the triple sink. Discussed with PIC to use either paint or some sort of sealant for these wood surfaces. Ensure by the next routine inspection in 2025 that this area of the bar has had the wood sealed to make the surfaces smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
4-101.11: (A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be safe. P Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be: (B) Durable, nonabsorbent, and CORROSION-RESISTANT (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion. C

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The bar area is observed to have an accumulation of debris underneath equipment and around the bar area on the floor. Ensure equipment is pulled away from the wall at a frequency necessary to maintain the physical facilities clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.citation_text:
2-102.11 (A), (B) & (C)(1), (4)-(16) Person in charge (PIC) at the start of inspection was unable to answer questions about potential food service on weekends and the disinfectant available for use. A priority violation was also observed for handwashing. Facility manager arrived during inspection and was able to demonstrate knowledge.  Manager was advised to ensure all staff, regardless of the number of days they work at the facility, are able to demonstrate knowledge on all topics based on risks inherent to the establishment.
Based on the risks inherent to the food operation, during inspections and upon request the PIC shall demonstrate to the regulatory authority knowledge of foodborne disease prevention, application of the hazard analysis and critical control points, and the requirements of the Code.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 Employee was observed handling cell phone and did not wash hands prior to handling and stocking single service cups and stirs at the bar. Employee was advised on handwashing between tasks. Employee was later observed washing hands between tasks as needed.
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Hands must also be washed after engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.citation_text:
3-201.11 Evidence was observed on the Shamrock Tavern Facebook page to indicate food service is occurring at the facility beyond what is allowed under the current permit classification. Screenshots of posts from 10/17/21, 10/24/21, and 11/7/21 were provided that showed foods such as chili, mostaccioli, and salad were served. The facility is currently permitted as Class III low risk and is not allowed to serve foods such as the aforementioned items without upgrading to a Class II medium risk permit or obtaining temporary food service permits for special events if they wish to maintain a Class III low risk permit. Temporary food permit applications were provided, and bar manager stated temporary permits will be obtained moving forward.
Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with the law.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-304.11 Ice scoop used at main ice machine was observed with the food contact surface in direct contact with a damp, plastic grocery sack in the bottom of a rusty beer bucket. Scoop was set aside to be cleaned and sanitized at the 3 part sink. Proper storage was discussed. Provide another container for storage of the ice scoop. 
Food shall only contact surfaces of equipment and utensils that are cleaned and sanitized as specified under Parts 4-6 and 4-7 of the 2017 FDA Food Code; single-service/single-use articles, or linens such as cloth napkins, as specified under § 3-304.13 that are laundered as specified under Part 4-8 of this Code.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Mold accumulation was observed on the metal baffle in the ice machine. Buildup was also present in the top part of the machine where ice maker is located. Cleaning frequency was discussed. 
-Mold buildup was observed around the seal of the soda gun where the nozzle attaches. Ensure cleaning as needed to eliminate buildup.
Equipment such as beverage dispensing nozzles and with enclosed components, such as ice bins a machines, shall be cleaned at a frequency specified by the manufacturer, or absent manufacturer specifications, at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text:
7-102.11 Four spray bottles of a yellowish colored liquid were observed at the bar. Two bottles were labeled as Buckeye Eco Neutral Disinfectant. One spray bottle did not have any labeling. The fourth bottle was a Purell food service sanitizer bottle that was being re-used. 
The two bottles without proper labeling were labeled as to the contents. All four bottles contained the same general disinfectant. Proper labeling of toxics was discussed. 
Working containers used for storing poisonous or toxic materials such as cleaners and sanitizers taken from bulk supplies and/or prepared on-site shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11 Bottles of juice were observed on the floor in the walkin cooler. Store food up off the floor in the walkin cooler.
Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches above the floor.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.citation_text:
4-903.11 Boxes of single use cups and portion cups (shot glasses) were observed on the floor in the storage area. Store boxes up off the floor. 
Single service and single use articles shall be stored in a clean, dry location, where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above the floor.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.citation_text:
6-202.14  Men's room door was not shutting properly. When closed it did not seal to be flush with the door frame. Repair the door so it shuts and seals properly.
All toilet rooms located within a food establishment must be enclosed with a tight-fitting and self-closing door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 & 6-501.12 Floors were soiled under and around the ice machine, mopsink, and the ice bin at the bar. Ensure cleaning of floors as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair, and cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12 & 2-301.14 PIC touched soda gun nozzle without first washing hands and was observed scratching nose prior to handling the soda gun. Handwashing between tasks was discussed. 
PIC came in from smoking and immediately washed hands. However, a barrier was not used to shut off the manual faucet. Proper handwashing technique was discussed. 
Educational handouts on technique, when to wash hands, and proper glove use were provided. 
Food employees shall properly wash their hands with the following procedure: (1) rinse under clean, running warm water; (2) apply soap; (3) rub together vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds; (4) thoroughly rinse under clean, running warm water; and (5) immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying. 
 To avoid recontaminating hands, use a disposable paper towel or similar clean barrier when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a handwashing sink.
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Hands must also be washed engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
6-301.14 Handwashing signage was not posted at the bar handsink or in the restrooms. Handwashing signs were provided and posted during inspection. 
A sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands shall be provided at all handwashing sinks used by food employees and shall be clearly visible to food employees.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114 Quat solution at 3 part sink was observed at less than 100ppm. Only one tablet was used to make the solution. Two more tablets were added to bring the concentration to 200ppm. Ensure at least 3-4 tablets are used to make sanitizing solution for ware washing, and use test strips to verify concentration is 200-400ppm.
A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Mold accumulation was observed on the metal baffle in the ice machine. Buildup was also present in the top part of the machine where ice maker is located. Baffle was cleaned and sanitized during inspection. A layer of ice was discarded after wash, rinse, and sanitize of baffle was completed. Detail cleaning in the upper ice maker will occur when the machine is emptied. 
Equipment with enclosed components, such as ice machines, shall be cleaned at a frequency specified by the manufacturer, or absent manufacturer specifications, at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11 Bottles of juice and tray of sliced citrus were observed on the floor in the walkin cooler. Store food up off the floor in the walkin cooler.
Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches above the floor.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Quat test kit was water damaged. Options for storage to minimize water damage were discussed. Manager was provided with a few strips to get through the current operating day. Manager will email a photo to inspector tomorrow after new set of test strips are purchased. 
A test kit that accurately measures the concentration of sanitizing solutions shall be provided. Obtain and use quat test strips with sanitizer used on food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.citation_text:
6-202.14  Men's room door was not shutting properly. When closed it did not seal to be flush with the door frame. Repair the door so it shuts and seals properly.
All toilet rooms located within a food establishment must be enclosed with a tight-fitting and self-closing door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 & 6-501.12 Floor at bar was soiled with buildup of bottle caps around the ice bin. 
--Floor under/behind the ice machine and chest freezer were soiled with buildup of general debris.
--Gap was observed around the drain line from the mopsink where it enters the floor to go to the basement. Seal around the gap.
--Women's room was observed with loose wall tiles beneath the water lines on the left side of the toilet. Gaps were also present along junctures of walls and where the wall meets the floor between the sink and the toilet. Repair the tiles and seal the gaps.
--Men's' room handsink had sections where caulk was damaged and no longer properly sealed. Repair the seals at the sink to all junctures.
--Gaps/holes were observed around/behind plumbing in the cabinets below the restroom handsinks. Seal the areas.
--Tile was damaged in the wall above the men's room handsink where the door handle hits. Repair the damaged wall tiles.
--Women's room cabinet beneath handsink had what appeared to be old mouse dropping inside. Clean the cabinet.
NOTE: The aforementioned list is not all inclusive. Clean and make repairs throughout the facility where needed.
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair, and cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text:
750.120 - Bag of popping corn was observed open. Bartender on duty had not yet made popcorn for the day; the bag was left open from the previous evening. Close the bag between uses.

Single use gloves could not be located during the inspection. Bartender stated the gloves were normally located on the shelf in the ice machine room. Gloves are needed for slicing citrus and preparing frozen pizza. Obtain and use single use gloves for handling food.

Foods shall be properly stored and protected at all times.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.citation_text:
750.290 - Ice scoop was observed on the counter across from the ice machine. The counter had some debris on it. Store the scoop in a clean container between uses.

Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.510 - Bartender was observed washing hands without proper technique. Manual faucet was shut off without a barrier, and the process took less than 20 seconds. Proper handwashing was discussed. Educational handout provided.

Employees shall properly wash hands any time hands may have been contaminated, between tasks, and prior to handling food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.citation_text:
750.820 - Concentration of sanitizer at 3 part sink was less than 100ppm quat. Bartender stated one tablet was used to make the solution. Two more tablets were added, and the solution was then observed at proper concentration of 200ppm. 
NOTE: Per the label of the Sani-Tabs, the effective concentration for the sanitizer is 200-400ppm. Maintain solutions in the 3 part sink for sanitizing during ware washing within this range. Use test strips to verify proper concentration.

Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
7500.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) soda gun holder (mold) - cleaned and sanitized during inspection;
B) popcorn scoops (oil/popcorn debris) - cleaned and sanitized during inspection;  and
C) ice machine - metal baffle (mold).

Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed, up to every 4hrs after continuous use, to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text:
750.880 - Box of plastic cups was observed on the floor in the ice machine room. Store the box of cups at least 6 inches off the floor.

Single service articles must be stored, handled, and dispensed in a manner that protects items from potential contamination.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text:
750.1120 - Women's room door was not self-closing to be flush with the door frame. Repair the door so the women's room door properly self closes. 

All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text:
750.1170 - Gap was observed along the bottom of the front entrance on the south side of the building. Bartender tried to reattach the hard, plastic weather stripping that fits along the bottom of the door, but the strip kept coming off. Bartender noted she has re-attached the weather strip several times to no avail. The hard plastic strip needs to be permanently attached so it does not pop off, or an alternative weather stripping needs to be installed (i.e. bristle strip, etc.). End result needs to be a self-closing door that is tight fitting and vermin proof.

Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750-1120 Neither toilet room has a self-closing door. Provide self-closers for these toilet rooms.  All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1200 The floor behind the bar is starting to show signs of wear in various places (especially infront of the soda gun). All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
750-1220 The plumbing underneath the 3-compartment sink is dusty. Clean the plumbing. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.
750-1210 REPEAT: The toilet rooms have missing tiles around the walls. Repair the walls so the surfaces are smooth and easily cleanable. All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750-1310  Observed spray bottles of air fresheners stored over the pizza oven and ice scoop. Moved during the inspection. Cease storing chemicals over food or equipment. All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: 750-1300 Spray bottle of floor cleaner is observed hanging from the mop sink without a label. Employee was unaware what exactly was in the spray bottle. Labeled 'cleaner' during inspection. Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment: 750-290 There are two ice scoops observed stored on top of a soiled ice machine. Store ice scoops on a clean surface - clean the top of the ice machine or use an adjacent clean surface for storage. Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-690 Observed the wood 2x 4s behind the handsink and the mop sink to be not properly sealed to the wall. Use silicon caulking to seal the sink to the wood and then the wood to the wall. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) The baffle of the ice machine is observed with minimal mold accumulation. Clean the baffle of the ice machine. To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Observed the pizza oven drip tray to be soiled. Clean the drip tray. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment: 750-1050 Observed a filled-to-the brim bucket of waste water from the first sink of the three compartment sink. The bucket has overflowed onto the floor resulting in grease and water accumulation. See violation #35a. Keep waste water buckets emptied and cleaned daily. All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: 750-1100(b) There is an apparent leak from the 3-part sink (see violation #28). Also, the drainline from the soda gun cup is missing. Call Coke and have them replace the drainline. Remove the waste water from the bucket and see if there is indeed a leak at the sink. Plumbing of sink is observed dusty across the pipes and then greasy beneath the first sink. Gasket of first sink may be leaking at sink basin. Drain lines from equipment shall not discharge waste water in such a manner as will permit the flooding of floors or the flowing of water across working or walking areas or into difficult-to-clean areas, or otherwise create a nuisance.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: 750-1160 Observed a number of drain flies around the floor where an overflowing bucket and grease is observed. Empty bucket, clean floor, and eliminate pests. Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1200 The coving of the storage/pizza oven room is present in the room but not installed. Eliminate the gap between the wall and the floors. Also, the floor of the bar has beer bottles and caps stored where the back of the counter meets the floor. The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1220 A tile has fallen from the wall in the womens toilet room. Replace the missing tile by the stool. Also, the plumbing beneath the 3-compartment sink is soiled with dust adn grease. Clean the plumbing. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: 750-1300 Observed an unlabeled spray bottle of chemical hanging off the three compartment sink. During the inspection, the liquid was determined to be cleaner (non-food contact) and was labeled as such. Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: 750-1390 Observed a mop stored head-to-ground in the mop sink room. Properly invert mops to allow for proper drying and deter pests.  Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similiar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleansable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices. The cutting board at the bar is scored and rough so that it is not easily cleansable. Replace the cutting board when it gets rough from ware.

findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.comment: 750-820a For manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing of utensils and equipment, a sink with no fewer then three compartments shall be provided and used. Use the sinks in wash, rinse and sanitize order. Air dry utensils and make sure that they have a one minute contact time in 200ppm solution of sanitizer.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. Provide proper chemical test strips.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. The drop guard of the ice machine has mold on it. Wash, rinse and sanitize the ice machine.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Repair floor where tile is missing behind bar. Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Some of the base boards and some areas on floor behind bar are soiled. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents. The ceiling in the dry storage is not sealed to the walls. Also an area of the wall next to the floor in the men's restroom is in disrepair. Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
